findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: kit_download · Private data: dataset_sample, citation_watch, free_kit, connect_tracker, search_companies, data_signup, data_records, data_orders, kit_download · Public sink: free_kit, connect_tracker, data_signup · Destructive: aeo_audit.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: kit_download · Private data: dataset_sample, citation_watch, free_kit, connect_tracker, search_companies, data_signup, data_records, data_orders, kit_download · Public sink: free_kit, connect_tracker, data_signup · Destructive: aeo_audit

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
